camera.label: RealSense D435i

depth.clipping_note: Chosen navigation observation window, based on the ideal operating range; not a hardware maximum or guaranteed accuracy range.

rgb.clipping_note: Synthetic RGB renderer clipping only; independent of the depth observation window.

camera.mount_note: Preserved viewer mounting assumption, not a D435i hardware specification. Body roll and pitch remain zero.
camera.baseline_note: Left/right IR baseline from datasheet; not an RGB-depth translation. Stereo matching is not simulated.
camera.rgb_depth_extrinsics: Co-located optical centers and parallel optical axes are an explicit approximation until device calibration is supplied. Streams retain separate projections and are not pixel-aligned.
camera.intrinsics_note: Derived from nominal HD FOV; preview images sample the same angular envelope at reduced resolution. Not measured CameraInfo or distortion calibration.
camera.optical_frame: x right, y down, z forward; depth is optical-axis Z in meters; invalid depth is zero
camera.simulation_scope: Ideal mesh first-hit visibility only; no active stereo matching, IR texture, depth noise, rolling shutter or IMU simulation. Reference replay sampling is independent of nominal sensor FPS.

tables: 3-49: D435i HD depth FOV, 50mm IR baseline and OV2740 RGB FOV

sources.use: Ideal operating range of 0.3 to 3m; selected as the simulation observation window
